questions.stem: 演算法（algorithm）會推薦和我們按過讚的貼文類似的內容，這正是我們放不下手機的原因。
questions.answer: Algorithms recommend content similar to the posts we have liked, which is why it is hard for us to put down our phones.
accepted_answers: Algorithms suggest content that is similar to the posts we have liked, which explains why we find it hard to put our phones down.
Algorithms recommend content that resembles the posts we have liked, which is the reason why we can't put down our phones.

questions.stem: 凡是想擺脫這種循環的人，無論演算法推薦什麼，都應該主動接觸多元的觀點。
questions.answer: Those who want to break free from this cycle should actively expose themselves to diverse perspectives, no matter what algorithms recommend.
accepted_answers: No matter what the algorithms recommend, those who hope to escape this cycle should take the initiative to explore a variety of viewpoints.
Those who wish to get out of this cycle should actively seek out different points of view, no matter what algorithms suggest.

1.explanation_zh: 「這正是…的原因」指前面整件事（演算法推薦類似的內容），英文用非限定關係子句 , which is why …，which 前面要有逗號，不能用 that。「我們按過讚的貼文」是限定關係子句 the posts (that) we have liked，受格關代可以省略；「按讚」就是動詞 like，已經按過用現在完成式。be similar to 的介系詞是 to。「放不下手機」可寫 it is hard for us to put down our phones 或 we can't put our phones down。
1.strategy_zh: 看到「，這正是／這也是…的原因」，先想 , which is why …；看到「…的＋名詞」，把修飾語搬到名詞後面變成關係子句。
hints: 切成四段：演算法會推薦／和我們按過讚的貼文類似的內容／這正是…的原因／我們放不下手機
標的詞彙：recommend（推薦）、content（內容）、similar（類似的）、post（貼文）、phone（手機）
句型框架：S + V + N + similar to + N + (that) + S + have p.p., which is why + S + V …

2.explanation_zh: 「凡是…的人」用 those who＋複數動詞（或 anyone who＋單數動詞）。「無論演算法推薦什麼」用 no matter what algorithms recommend（= whatever algorithms recommend），後面是直述句語序。「主動」修飾動詞用副詞 actively；「接觸多元的觀點」不要直譯成 contact，用 expose oneself to／seek out diverse perspectives。「都」是配合「無論」的語氣，不需要譯成 all。
evidence: 凡是想擺脫這種循環的人
2.strategy_zh: 「無論…都…」先找主幹（誰應該做什麼），no matter 子句可以放句首或句尾；「凡是…的人」直接想 Those who …。
hints: 切成四段：凡是想擺脫這種循環的人／無論演算法推薦什麼／都應該主動／接觸多元的觀點
標的詞彙：escape（擺脫）、cycle（循環）、recommend（推薦）、actively（主動地）、diverse（多元的）、perspective（觀點）
句型框架：Those who + V … should + V …, no matter what + S + V

references: Algorithms recommend content similar to the posts we have liked, which is why it is hard for us to put down our phones.
Algorithms suggest content that is similar to the posts we have liked, which explains why we find it hard to put our phones down.
Algorithms recommend content that resembles the posts we have liked, which is the reason why we can't put down our phones.

patterns.label_zh: 非限定關係子句（which 指前面整件事）
patterns.frame: S + V …, which is why + S + V …

patterns.label_zh: 限定關係子句（可省略受格關代 that）

accepted: Algorithms recommend
Algorithms suggest
Algorithms will recommend
Algorithms tend to recommend
The algorithm recommends

common_errors.explanation_zh: 泛指演算法要用複數 Algorithms（或 The algorithm recommends）；單數可數名詞不能單獨當主詞，主詞和動詞也要一致。
recommend 不接雙受詞，要寫 recommend sth (to sb)。

parts.zh: 和我們按過讚的貼文類似的內容
accepted: content similar to the posts we have liked
content that is similar to the posts we have liked
content that resembles the posts we have liked
content similar to the posts that we have liked
content similar to the posts we liked
content like the posts we have liked

common_errors.wrong: content similar with the posts we have liked
common_errors.right: content similar to the posts we have liked
common_errors.explanation_zh: be similar to 的介系詞是 to，不是 with。

common_errors.wrong: similar to we have liked posts content
common_errors.right: content similar to the posts we have liked
common_errors.explanation_zh: 中文把修飾語放在名詞前面，英文要把關係子句放在名詞後面：the posts (that) we have liked。

accepted: which is why
which explains why
which is the reason why
which is the reason

common_errors.wrong: we have liked, this is why it is hard
common_errors.right: we have liked, which is why it is hard
common_errors.explanation_zh: 逗號不能連接兩個完整的句子（逗點謬誤）；用 which 指前面整件事，或改用句號再寫 This is why。

common_errors.wrong: we have liked, that is why it is hard
common_errors.right: we have liked, which is why it is hard
common_errors.explanation_zh: 非限定關係子句不能用 that；that is why 是獨立句，不能只用逗號接上。

accepted: it is hard for us to put down our phones
we find it hard to put our phones down
we can't put down our phones
we can hardly put our phones down
it is difficult for us to put our phones down
we cannot put down our phones

common_errors.right: we can't put down our phones
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「放下」是 put down，down 不能漏掉。

common_errors.wrong: it is hard for us putting down our phones
common_errors.right: it is hard for us to put down our phones
common_errors.explanation_zh: It is + 形容詞 + for sb 後面接不定詞 to V。

traps.literal_error: Algorithm recommends content similar to the posts we have liked …
traps.explanation_zh: 「演算法」泛指一類東西，英文用複數 Algorithms 或加冠詞 The algorithm；單數可數名詞不能沒有冠詞。

traps.zh: 和我們按過讚的貼文類似的內容
traps.literal_error: Algorithms recommend similar to we have liked posts content …
traps.explanation_zh: 中文兩層「的」都放在名詞前面；英文要先寫 content，再接 similar to the posts (that) we have liked。

bonus.text: So closely does the content algorithms recommend match the posts we have liked that it is hard for us to put down our phones.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用 So + 副詞 + 助動詞 + 主詞 + V … that … 的倒裝強調「推薦內容和我們的喜好有多像」；屬於加分寫法，基本分仍看 which is why 的寫法。

1.restructuring_zh: 「這正是我們放不下手機的原因」不要另起一句 This is the reason …，改用 , which is why … 把前面整件事當先行詞接上；「和我們按過讚的貼文類似的內容」要把修飾語移到 content 後面（content similar to the posts we have liked）。

references: Those who want to break free from this cycle should actively expose themselves to diverse perspectives, no matter what algorithms recommend.
No matter what the algorithms recommend, those who hope to escape this cycle should take the initiative to explore a variety of viewpoints.
Those who wish to get out of this cycle should actively seek out different points of view, no matter what algorithms suggest.

patterns.label_zh: 讓步子句：無論…（no matter what = whatever）
patterns.frame: S + V …, no matter what + S + V ／ No matter what + S + V, S + V …

patterns.zh_trigger: 凡是想擺脫這種循環的人

parts.zh: 凡是想擺脫這種循環的人
accepted: Those who want to break free from this cycle
those who hope to escape this cycle
Those who wish to get out of this cycle
Anyone who wants to escape this cycle
Whoever wants to escape this cycle
People who want to break out of this cycle

common_errors.wrong: Those who wants to escape this cycle
common_errors.right: Those who want to escape this cycle
common_errors.explanation_zh: those 是複數，who 子句的動詞用複數 want。

common_errors.wrong: Who wants to escape this cycle should
common_errors.right: Those who want to escape this cycle should
common_errors.explanation_zh: who 不能單獨當主詞，要有先行詞 those／anyone，或改用 Whoever wants …。

accepted: no matter what algorithms recommend
no matter what the algorithms recommend
no matter what algorithms suggest
whatever algorithms recommend
whatever the algorithms recommend
regardless of what algorithms recommend

common_errors.wrong: no matter what do algorithms recommend
common_errors.explanation_zh: no matter what 後面接直述句語序（主詞＋動詞），不要加助動詞倒裝成問句。
what 要緊跟在 no matter 後面，再接主詞與動詞。

accepted: should actively
should take the initiative to
should make an effort to
should make a point of

common_errors.explanation_zh: 修飾動詞要用副詞 actively；active 是形容詞。
這裡的「都」是配合「無論」的語氣，不必譯成 all。

accepted: expose themselves to diverse perspectives
explore a variety of viewpoints
seek out different points of view
seek out diverse perspectives
be open to different points of view
look for a variety of perspectives

common_errors.explanation_zh: contact 是「聯絡（人）」；「接觸觀點」要說 expose oneself to／seek out／be open to。
修飾名詞要用形容詞 diverse；diversity 是名詞。

traps.explanation_zh: 「接觸」是抽象的「去看、去聽不同的觀點」，不是 contact（聯絡某人）；用 expose oneself to／seek out。

traps.literal_error: All want to escape this cycle people should …
traps.explanation_zh: 「…的人」要寫成 those who …／anyone who …，修飾語放在後面；「凡是」不必譯成 all。

bonus.text: Whatever algorithms may recommend, those who long to break free from this cycle should make a point of exposing themselves to diverse perspectives.
bonus.explanation_zh: Whatever = no matter what；make a point of V-ing（刻意去做）比 should actively 更道地。

2.restructuring_zh: 中文「凡是…的人，無論…，都應該…」三段排在一起；英文以 Those who … should … 當主幹，把 no matter what 子句移到句尾（或句首加逗號），「都」不必譯出。

1.translation: Algorithms recommend content similar to the posts we have liked, which is exactly why we can't put down our phones.
1.explanation_zh: 「這正是…的原因」用非限定關係子句 which is exactly why 承接前句；「按過讚」用現在完成式 have liked；「放不下手機」譯為 can't put down our phones。

2.translation: Whoever wants to break free from this cycle should actively seek out diverse perspectives, no matter what the algorithms recommend.
2.explanation_zh: 「凡是想…的人」用 whoever 引導名詞子句當主詞；「無論演算法推薦什麼」用 no matter what，放句尾比夾在主詞與動詞之間自然；「主動接觸多元的觀點」譯為 actively seek out diverse perspectives（也可用 expose themselves to）。

issues_zh: （建議，不影響判定）我寫 which is exactly why，把「正是」的「正」譯成 exactly；第 3 部分 accepted 只有 which is why 等，可補上 which is exactly why。第 4 部分中文標示沒包含句尾「的原因」，英文 which is why 已涵蓋，不影響評分。
（說明）「凡是…的人」我用 Whoever（複合關係代名詞）而不是 Those who；第 1 部分 accepted 有 Whoever wants to escape this cycle，所以算 REL，但若程式只比對 who 引導的 those who／anyone who，可能比對不到。

1.translation: An algorithm recommends content similar to the posts we have liked, which is exactly why we cannot put our phones down.
1.explanation_zh: 「這正是……的原因」用非限定關係子句 which is exactly why 接前句；按過讚是已發生並延續到現在的經驗，用現在完成式 have liked 修飾 posts。

2.translation: Anyone who wants to break free from this cycle should actively seek out diverse perspectives, no matter what the algorithm recommends.
2.explanation_zh: 「凡是想……的人」用 Anyone who；「無論……」用 no matter what 引導讓步子句；主動接觸譯成 actively seek out。
